title: AI Linocut Generator
summary: Make linocut and block print art with AI. Describe the scene, pick a linocut style, and Flick prints bold carved shapes, gouge marks and flat ink colours.
body_markdown:
### How do I make linocut art with AI?


Describe the subject, the number of ink colours, the carved textures and the paper, such as a two-colour linocut of a fox in a snowy forest with gouge lines in the sky, then pick a linocut style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the print into a clip.


### Can AI turn a photo into a linocut?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference image and ask for it redrawn as a linocut, naming the colours and the carving marks you want; keep the composition words, such as "keep the same pose and framing", so the print follows the photo.


### Can I use an AI linocut as a design to carve?


Yes. Ask for a single-colour black linocut with no gradients, so every area is either ink or paper, then print it at the size of your block and transfer it; the generated cut marks show where to carve.


### Can I make a linocut style video?


Yes. Generate the print first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe a small motion, such as the fox walking or snow falling, while asking to keep the carved texture and flat colours.


### Is the linocut generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
